title: integration test chat_set_duplicate_direct_cleanup_destroy_failure is clock-dependent
description: crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/integration.rs:2087 seeds a race phantom with id "aaaa" and expects the newly created Chat to be lex-larger so the handler destroys it. Server ids are now time-derived hex (e.g. 18dfc7d3a4fc14ee), which sort before "aaaa", so no cleanup destroy runs and notCreated[c0] is absent. Fails on clean HEAD 6c1a857a (found while working JMAP-yt1w.7). Fix the test premise (pick a phantom id guaranteed lex-smaller, e.g. "0"), not the assertion.
notes: 2026-10-18 (JMAP-yt1w.13 run): also fails deterministically in isolation at HEAD abf6969a with 'cargo test -p jmap-chat-server --all-features --test integration chat_set_duplicate_direct_cleanup_destroy_failure' (realistic-demo-ids on): Chat/set create lands in created instead of notCreated serverFail.
